gloss: outgoing call history; sent message log

definitions.gloss: outgoing call history; sent message log
definitions.explanation: A record of calls made or messages sent from a phone or device. A standard feature on mobile phones and communication apps.

examples.japanese: {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the outgoing call history.

examples.japanese: {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}から{相手|あいて}の{番号|ばんごう}をもう{一度|いちど}かけ{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I called the number again from the outgoing call history.

examples.japanese: スマホの{発信履歴|はっしんりれき}を{見|み}ると、{昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}に{知|し}らない{番号|ばんごう}に{何度|なんど}も{電話|でんわ}をかけた{形跡|けいせき}があった。
examples.english: Looking at my phone's outgoing call history, there were traces of multiple calls to an unknown number last night.

notes:
Composed of {発信|はっしん} (transmission, sending) and {履歴|りれき} (history, log, record). A practical technology term that anyone with a smartphone encounters regularly.

USAGE:
Primarily used in the context of phone calls and messaging. On Japanese smartphones, the call log typically shows {発信履歴|はっしんりれき} (outgoing), {着信履歴|ちゃくしんりれき} (incoming), and {不在着信|ふざいちゃくしん} (missed calls) as separate views.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the outgoing call log
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}を{削除|さくじょ}する: to delete the outgoing call history
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}から{電話|でんわ}する: to call from the outgoing log
- {発信履歴|はっしんりれき}の{一覧|いちらん}: outgoing call list

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着信履歴|ちゃくしんりれき}: incoming call history — the record of calls received
- {通話履歴|つうわりれき}: call history — a broader term covering both incoming and outgoing calls
- {不在着信|ふざいちゃくしん}: missed call — a call that was not answered
- {履歴|りれき}: history, log — the general term for any recorded history (browsing history, call history, etc.)
